scope: Independent skeptical mathematical review of D3 only; read AGENTS.md, README introduction and PROJECT_STATE stage/objective/unattended_assurance; no other reviews inspected; no proof or production edits.

comprehension.claim: Conditional per-epoch allocations with an almost-sure lifetime budget control the countable union of failures. Separately, a nonnegative supermartingale yields time-uniform coverage, and correctly specified causal predictive likelihood ratios construct a martingale.
comprehension.conditional_epoch_check: For each deterministic epoch index e, the tower property applies regardless of dependence or random start time. Nonnegativity permits exchanging expectation and countably infinite sums by monotone convergence. A pathwise budget bounds its expectation. Unstarted epochs contribute zero. No independence or disjointness is used.
comprehension.stopping_and_measurability_check: In discrete time, adaptedness makes threshold hitting a stopping time. At each finite t, stopped variables are integrable because they are finite sums of integrable M_s times indicators. The stopped increment equals 1_{tau>t}(M_{t+1}-M_t), with an F_t-measurable indicator, proving the claimed supermartingale inequality. Nonnegativity supplies the threshold probability bound; increasing finite horizons avoids assumptions about integrability at an unbounded stopping time. Coverage concerns each fixed truth, so no union over an uncountable parameter space is required. Set/event measurability is expressly assumed.
comprehension.likelihood_check: Reading density in its usual conditional-kernel sense with a common dominating measure, past measurability, normalization and q support within positive p give conditional mean one for each ratio. Conditional expectation for nonnegative variables first justifies multiplication by the past product; induction then proves finite mean one and integrability. Adapted actions are included in the conditioning.
comprehension.counterexample_search: Repeated independent positive-risk restarts approach failure probability one, as stated. If q places mass where p is zero, the mean-one identity can fail, though a supermartingale may remain possible; the stated support assumption excludes that case. If q is selected after a fair binary observation to put unit mass on its observed value, the ratio is always two, violating mean one; past measurability excludes this case. Choosing the start of a test after inspecting the data it tests can invalidate conditional calibration, and is excluded by the explicit conditional guarantee premise. None is a counterexample satisfying all stated premises.
comprehension.limits: This proves sufficient mathematical conditions, not their validity for H7, aging battery observations, restart persistence or finite-precision firmware.

remaining_application_obligations: Specify the actual filtration, epoch start stopping times and start-information sigma-fields, including recorded actions and all policy information affecting observations; justify measurability of allocations and failure events.

Prove each actual epoch failure guarantee conditional on its start information, including data-dependent starts and reuse of prior observations; unconditional or fixed-start calibration alone is insufficient.
Choose a lifetime risk budget and prove its almost-sure accounting across resets, storage loss and every epoch; alternatively prove a valid bounded-boot or other lifetime guarantee.

Establish a correct admitted conditional measurement law, common density representation, predictable normalized q kernels, support and finite-ratio assumptions, including ADC behavior, noise, hidden state and adaptive actions.
Establish that a fixed admitted parameter represents the true process, or replace the construction with a separately proved aging/time-varying model.
Prove measurability and sound finite-precision outer approximation of the confidence sets, plus a practical construction with qualified target memory and runtime.
Establish useful availability under shrinking risk allocations; probability control alone does not ensure useful battery-state outputs.

validation.method: Direct proof audit and adversarial premise-removal examples; no empirical test can establish the application premises.
validation.artifact_policy: Created exclusively; original proof and existing review artifacts preserved.
